short_description: All-in-one practice management with integrated billing, clearinghouse connectivity, and optional managed RCM services from the Kareo + PatientPop merger.
long_description: Tebra Billing is the revenue cycle management component of the Tebra platform, formed through the 2021 merger of Kareo (practice management and billing) with PatientPop (patient engagement and marketing). The billing module provides comprehensive insurance billing capabilities including electronic claims submission, real-time eligibility verification, ERA auto-posting, and patient billing features. Tebra offers both self-service billing (where practices submit their own claims) and managed billing services (where Tebra's team handles the full revenue cycle). The platform uses Change Healthcare and other clearinghouses for claims submission to thousands of payers. With over 100,000 providers on the combined platform, Tebra is particularly popular with small to mid-size independent practices seeking an integrated solution for EHR, practice management, and billing. The company has raised over $100 million in funding and serves practices across multiple specialties including behavioral health.

faqs.q: Is Tebra the same as Kareo?
faqs.a: Yes, Tebra was formed in 2021 through the merger of Kareo (practice management and billing) and PatientPop (patient engagement). Kareo's billing and practice management solutions now operate under the Tebra brand, combining both companies' capabilities into a unified platform.

faqs.q: How much does Tebra managed billing cost?
faqs.a: Tebra's managed billing service typically charges 4-7% of collected revenue, depending on specialty, claim volume, and complexity. This is competitive with industry standards. The managed service handles claims submission, denial management, AR follow-up, and patient billing on behalf of the practice.

faqs.q: Does Tebra work for mental health practices?
faqs.a: Yes, Tebra supports mental health practices and includes behavioral health billing codes and workflows. However, it's a multi-specialty platform not specifically designed for mental health. Practices may find mental health-specific solutions like SimplePractice or TherapyNotes better optimized for therapy workflows.

Tebra uses Change Healthcare and other clearinghouses for electronic claims submission. The platform connects to thousands of payers nationwide including all major commercial insurers, Medicare, and Medicaid programs.
